title: Implement independent v2 fixtures and contradictory foundation tests
purpose: Create independent valid and adversarial v2 fixtures plus contract, storage-isolation, browser vertical-slice and build-determinism tests. The QA role specifies and attacks public behavior without modifying runtime, authoring, build, workflow or contract files.
invariants: QA does not modify implementation to make tests pass.
The valid fixture conforms to the frozen schema and has correct semantic references and canonical digests.
The legacy fixture uses the RC718 contract discriminator and must fail before any write.
The digest-mismatch fixture preserves a revision ID while changing immutable semantic payload.
Storage isolation covers all protected RC718 localStorage keys and learnit_durable_library_v1.
Browser tests exercise the visible UI and the bounded test API through the same runtime paths.
Build determinism compares two clean artifacts and exact source-manifest identity.
No file outside the seven exact allowed paths is created or changed.
requiredEvidence: Contract tests cover schema shape, UUID rules, duplicate IDs, broken references, QCM choice IDs, fill slot/token/maxUses semantics and digest agreement.
Storage tests snapshot RC718 localStorage values and IndexedDB records before and after successor boot, import, session and reset.
Browser tests cover empty state, valid import, legacy rejection, QCM, reusable fill token, progress, refresh and restart.
Build test fails on nondeterministic bytes, manifest drift or tested-artifact mismatch.
The role-local test commands and raw outputs are recorded and independently reproduced before integration.
All failures identify evidence separately from assumptions and implementation claims.
The result is independently reviewed before integration.
adversarialTests: Legacy package rejection leaves library and storage unchanged.
Malformed JSON, unknown properties, duplicate identifiers and broken references fail closed.
Same revision ID with different payload or digest is rejected.
QCM correctness remains stable after choice reordering.
Fill activities reject absent slot positions, duplicate slot answers and maxUses overflow.
Storage write failure produces no partial package installation.
Successor reset leaves every protected RC718 value and database record unchanged.
A second clean build produces the same artifact SHA-256.
nonGoals: Producing the two final golden kits.
Changing the schema or file plan.
Creating build, workflow, release or manifest files.
Entering backend, account, sync, catalog, commerce, tenancy or marketplace scope.
independentReview: Adversarial QA review confirms tests do not encode implementation shortcuts.
Storage review confirms the protected RC718 namespace list is complete for the accepted inventory.
Contract review confirms fixtures match the frozen v2 semantics.
Integrator confirms tests consume, but do not own, build and runtime outputs.

execution.validationPolicy: The existing fixed Remote Agent profiles do not execute the new successor tests. Any Remote Agent status is transport evidence only; role-local tests and raw outputs must be recorded and independently reproduced before integration.

rollback: Discard or revert the QA-only files. No implementation, RC718 data, contract or artifact is modified. Integration remains blocked without an accepted QA output.
